_readme: Company facts for qilich.com, read by the build (scripts/site.mjs): the About, Contact, Press and Privacy pages,
the Organization node of every page's JSON-LD, llms.txt and the analytics loaders.
Fill in only what is true and public. An empty string or an empty list is hidden everywhere: no placeholder is ever
shown to visitors and nothing empty goes into the structured data. After editing, run: npm run build
Telephone numbers are written as visitors see them (+998 97 270 70 07); the build derives the tel: form.
foundingDate is a year (2026) or a date (2026-10-01). sameAs lists full profile URLs (LinkedIn, GitHub, Clutch, Google Business Profile...).
analytics: a GA4 measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX) and a Yandex Metrika counter number. Both empty = no analytics code, no cookie banner.
lead.api: true once POST /api/lead exists in the Worker; until then the contact form opens the visitor's mail app.

description.uz: Qilich Toshkentda ishlaydigan yapon IT agenstvasi boʻlib, mobil ilovalar, saytlar, Telegram-botlar, backend tizimlar va AI integratsiyalarini yapon standartlarida quradi.
description.ru: Qilich — японское IT-агентство в Ташкенте, которое разрабатывает мобильные приложения, сайты, Telegram-ботов, бэкенд-системы и интеграции с ИИ по японским стандартам.
description.en: Qilich is a Japanese IT agency in Tashkent that builds mobile apps, websites, Telegram bots, backend systems and AI integrations to Japanese standards.
description.ja: Qilich（キリチ）は、ウズベキスタンのタシケントに開発チームを置き、iOS・Androidアプリ、Webシステム、業務システム、AI連携などの開発を日本の品質水準で手がけるIT企業です。
